relations.text: サウジの合弁持分25%をMa'aden株と交換し、株主に
relations.text_en: Swapped its 25% stake in a Saudi phosphate venture for Ma'aden shares

source.label: Mosaic 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On April 29, 2024, Saudi Arabian Mining Company (" Ma'aden ") and Mosaic entered into a Share Purchase and Subscription Agreement to exchange our 25 % ownership of the Ma'aden Wa'ad al Shamal Phosphate Company for 111,012,433 shares of Ma'aden.

relations.text: 北米以外へのカリ販売はCanpotex経由
relations.text_en: Sells potash outside the U.S. and Canada through Canpotex

source.label: Mosaic 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our sales of potash products outside of the U.S. and Canada are made through Canpotex.

relations.text: 2004年にCargillの肥料事業とIMCが統合して誕生
relations.text_en: Formed in 2004 by combining IMC with Cargill's crop nutrient business

source.label: Mosaic 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: " Cargill Crop Nutrition " means the crop nutrient business we acquired from Cargill in the Combination

relations.text: ICLが20-Fで、国際カリ市場の主な競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: ICL names Mosaic among significant international potash competitors

source.label: ICL Group 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: ICL's current significant competitors in the international potash market are Nutrien (Canada), Belaruskali (Belarus), Uralkali (Russia), Mosaic (Canada/Brazil)

relations.text: SQMが20-Fで、カリの主な競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: SQM names Mosaic among its main potash competitors

source.label: SQM 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Our main competitors are Uralkali, Belaruskali, Nutrien and Mosaic

relations.text: Brazil Potashが20-Fで、ブラジルでの最大級の競合に挙げる

source.quote: Upon commencement of our operations, some of our largest competitors would include The Mosaic Company in Brazil
